mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ai_conversation ( id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, user_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '村民ID', title VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT '新对话' COMMENT '对话标题', pinned TINYINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '置顶标记', msg_count INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '消息总数', last_action VARCHAR(60) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '最近动作类型', draft_data TEXT DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '申报草稿JSON', created_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, INDEX idx_user_pinned (user_id, pinned DESC, updated_at DESC) ) COMMENT 'AI 管家对话会话'
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id AS userId, title, pinned, msg_count AS msgCount, last_action AS lastAction, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM ai_conversation WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY pinned DESC, updated_at DESC
